members.name: title
members.doc: A short lead-in shown before the message in the label weight. It names the region when no label is given.

members.name: icon
members.doc: A decorative icon before the text, hidden from assistive technology.

members.name: tone
members.doc: The named colour. A valid customColor takes its place.

members.name: emphasis
members.doc: A tint of the colour over the surface, or the colour as a solid fill.

members.name: customColor
members.doc:
An opaque colour, as #rgb, #rrggbb or rgb(), in place of the tone. Text and controls on it are white or black, whichever
contrasts more. A colour that cannot be read or is not opaque falls back to the tone.

members.name: align
members.doc: Where the icon, text and actions sit: at the start, or centred as a group.

members.name: actions
members.doc: Up to two action Buttons.

members.name: link
members.doc: A Link after the actions.

members.name: dismissible
members.doc: Shows the dismiss button.

members.name: dismissed
members.doc: Whether the Banner is dismissed, when the caller controls it. A dismissed Banner renders nothing.

members.name: defaultDismissed
members.doc: Whether the Banner starts dismissed, when Banner controls it.

members.name: onDismiss
members.doc: Reports the dismiss button being pressed. Banner stores nothing.

members.name: dismissLabel
members.doc: The dismiss button's accessible name.

members.name: label
members.doc: The region's accessible name. Without it the title names the region, and without a title it is Notice.

members.name: alert
members.doc: Announces the Banner as an alert instead of a named region, for a notice that needs attention at once.
